title: Jolt custom methods
description: Describes what the host application provides to Jolt transformers (external methods and registered transformers), for code completion, hover, and validation. Applies to transformers in this folder and its subfolders, merged with files in parent folders up to the workspace root unless "root" is true.

root.description: When true, .jolt/methods.json files in parent folders are not merged with this one.

transformers.description: The names of the transformers that the host application registers, which #transformWith() can use (e.g. ["address"] for #transformWith($.address, 'address')). A #transformWith() call with any other literal name is reported as a problem. When none of the files that apply to a transformer have this property, its calls are not checked.

methods.description: The external methods registered with the transformers that this file applies to.

name.description: The method name (or its alias, if any) as used in a transformer, without the leading #. Names are case-sensitive.

description.description: Shown in completions and when hovering over the method.

returnType.description: The method's C# return type, shown in completions and when hovering over the method (e.g. string, int, IJsonToken?, EvaluationResult, or a type that Jolt serializes to JSON).

name.description: The parameter name, shown in the signature.

kind.description: "lambda" for a Func<> parameter, which completions insert as "@x: expression". Defaults to "value".

lambdaVariables.description: For a "lambda" parameter, the names of the variables it binds, in order (e.g. ["acc", "current"] for a Func<> with two inputs, written as @acc;@current: expression). Shown in signatures and used as completion placeholders. Defaults to a single variable, @x.
